visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A man dressed in a black chef's shirt, white hat, and a white apron stands in a clean, modern white kitchen. He leans against the white countertop and gestures with his right hand as if calling someone closer. (2) He holds a large stainless steel bowl containing various fresh ingredients including tomatoes, a potato, onions, and leafy greens. His facial expression is stern and demanding. (3) The camera focuses on a tight close-up of his face as he speaks intensely; he squints his eyes and shows visible annoyance while looking directly at the camera. (4) He holds up a piece of raw marbled beef rib, then a handful of celery, demonstrating cooking components against the backdrop of the tiled kitchen wall. (5) He points aggressively off-camera with a frustrated scowl, and a large red graphic overlay appears momentarily on screen. (6) A rapid camera movement pans across a living room area with light-colored chairs and tables before returning to the chef in the kitchen who is now placing a pot on the stove. (7) The man scratches his head and ear with a sheepish, confused expression before transitioning into a bright, enthusiastic demeanor. (8) He holds up two different cups of instant noodles, alternating between looking at them and the camera with wide eyes and a smile. (9) The video shows close-ups of noodles being lifted with chopsticks and the packaging of the product, alternating with the chef's animated reactions.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The scene opens with a male voice delivering authoritative, sharp dialogue in Chinese, punctuated by a bright 'ding' sound effect. A low-frequency hum provides a base layer while the speaker's intensity increases. (2) A metallic impact SFX sounds as the speaker's pitch spikes during an angry outburst. This is followed by a sudden 'whoosh' transition sound as the audio environment briefly shifts to a more resonant room tone. (3) A soft vocal sigh is heard, quickly followed by a short, high-pitched shout from a second male voice. The main speaker then resumes a rhythmic, scolding lecture with emphasized transients. (4) The audio transitions into an upbeat, high-tempo pop-rock background track with prominent synthesized drums and a major-key melody. The main speaker's voice becomes friendly and enthusiastic, like a narrator. (5) Wet slurping and crunchy foley sound effects are layered clearly over the music to simulate eating noodles. The audio concludes with a sudden, loud vocal surprise reaction and a quick cut to silence.
